# Valley Modern Plumbing & Hardware

> Valley Modern Plumbing & Hardware, Inc. is a licensed, insured, family-owned plumbing company in McAllen, Texas, serving the Rio Grande Valley since 1952. Three generations of the Hernandez family — founded by Genaro Hernandez Sr. and carried on today by Genaro Jr. and his son Andrew — handle residential and commercial plumbing: leak detection, drain cleaning, pipe and sewer repair, water heaters, repipes, gas lines, and fixture installation. An on-site hardware store means fixtures and parts are one stop, not three. Bilingual service (English/Spanish). Texas Master Plumber License #PM12745.

## About
- Business: Valley Modern Plumbing & Hardware, Inc.
- Founded: 1952 (three generations, Hernandez family)
- Owners: Genaro Hernandez Jr. and Andrew Hernandez
- License: Texas Master Plumber License #PM12745 — licensed and insured
- Address: 318 S. 23rd St, McAllen, TX 78501
- Phone: (956) 686-3687
- Hours: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM (closed Saturday and Sunday)
- Languages: English and Spanish (Hablamos Español)
- Serving: McAllen, Mission, Edinburg, Pharr, San Juan, Hidalgo, Weslaco, Mercedes, Harlingen, Brownsville, and the greater Rio Grande Valley

## Services
- Residential plumbing — repairs, repipes, fixture upgrades, bathroom additions
- Leak detection — non-invasive location of slab, wall, and underground leaks
- Drain cleaning — kitchen, bath, and main-line clog clearing
- Pipe repair — repair and replacement of corroded or leaking pipes (RGV hard-water damage)
- Sewer repair — diagnosis, camera inspection, repair, and replacement of sewer lines
- Water heater installation & replacement — tank and tankless, often same day, with haul-away
- Gas line services — outdoor kitchens, pool heaters, generators, whole-home connections
- Water filtration & softener systems — whole-home protection against RGV hard water
- Kitchen & bath renovation plumbing — permitted remodel and addition work
- Commercial plumbing repair — offices, retail, restaurants, healthcare, light-commercial
- Hardware store — on-site retail for fixtures, valves, fittings, and contractor-grade parts

## What to know
- Licensed and insured; ranks in the top 15% of Texas contractors (BuildZoom score 99).
- Same-day response available for most repairs — call early at (956) 686-3687.
- The team protects floors, cleans up completely, and backs workmanship with a warranty.
- Bilingual (English/Spanish) service throughout the Rio Grande Valley.
